verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents the chip's core or thread count or its boost clock behavior. It also contains no independent multi-core benchmark results such as compile times or parallel throughput. The only CPU-adjacent spec items are cTDP 45-120W and Curve Optimizer support, which describe power and tuning controls, not core counts or boost behavior. Community comments only allude vaguely to CPU-only benchmarks without giving any results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compile big codebases and run heavy parallel jobs fast — documented core counts and boost behavior, corroborated by independent multi-core benchmarks
